detail: Amalgamation/Merger - Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited has informed the Exchange about the receipt of Sanction from the Hon'ble NCLT, Chennai Bench towards the Scheme of Amalgamation between Dr. Agarwal s Eye Hospital Limited and Dr. Agarwal s Health Care Limited and their respective shareholders and creditors.
